prs.title: Strategy persistence, Fundamentals inline editors, docked chat panel & UI fixes
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: 2578 custom additions across 50 files spanning strategy persistence, inline editors, a docked chat panel, slide deck mechanics, and numerous UI fixes represents weeks of transformative, multi-system work.

prs.title: Product filtering, fundamentals scrollspy, and related UI
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: 959 custom lines across 23 files covering product filtering, a scrollspy navigation system, schema migrations, seed data, analytics, and multiple new/refactored components constitutes a major feature set.

prs.title: SM-445: agent context refactor, product scoped chat
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: 364 custom lines touching 44 files for a meaningful architectural refactor of agent context and introduction of product-scoped chat across many sub-agents and state modules is a significant, cross-cutting change.

prs.title: SM-442: adds integrated with back to the integration depth slide
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: 9 custom lines across 2 files adding a single UI option to an existing slide node is a small, focused addition.

prs.title: Ch/collector improvements
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: 757 custom lines across 60 files systematically improving collectors across stage-one and stage-two for many company and product fields, plus gap analysis and agent updates, represents a major feature enhancement.

prs.title: fix(SM-450): Assignee label uses email local part when name is missing
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: 63 custom lines across 6 files implementing a display-name utility with a unit test and wiring it into assignee and task components is a modest, well-scoped bug fix with proper test coverage.

stories.name: Strategy & Fundamentals Authoring Experience
stories.rationale: Delivered a cohesive strategy and fundamentals editing experience including persistence, inline editors, scrollspy navigation, product filtering, a docked chat panel, and related UI polish.

stories.name: AI Agent Context & Product-Scoped Chat
stories.rationale: Refactored agent context architecture and improved the collector, enabling product-scoped chat interactions and more accurate AI-driven data gathering.

stories.name: Integration Depth Signal Enhancement
stories.rationale: Added the 'integrated with' signal to the integration depth slide, improving the richness of integration assessment data.

stories.name: Assignee Display Name Fallback Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed assignee labels to gracefully fall back to the email local part when a user's full name is not available, improving readability across the platform.
